detail.longDescription: Why did we change the product terms on the website? "Agent #12, tool call #32, because Decision #234 was ratified by John on August 12, in response to a regulatory change." That's the kind of answer an organization should always be able to give. Most can't. I wrote about why AI memory and context drift are the wrong problem to solve, and why organizations need a shared Operational Reality instead: https:// smeldr.dev/thinking/operationa l-reality?utm_source=mastodon&utm_campaign=operational-reality # AI # AIAgents # AIGovernance # OperationalReality
